create_channel: create a new channel with name, type, and optional group or user memberships
add_members_to_channel: add users or groups as members to an existing channel by channel id
join_channel: join an existing channel as a new active member by channel id and user id
get_channel_by_id_and_user_id: get a channel by id with user-level access control and membership validation
create_webhook: create a webhook for a channel with a name and optional profile image URL
